description: The Little Book of Deep Learning by François Fleuret (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), Andrej Karpathy's nanoGPT and Hugging Face's text generation guide. Sign in as a guest and ask how a GPT works.
starterQuestions: How does causal self-attention work in nanoGPT, and how does the book explain it?
How is a GPT trained to predict the next token, in the book and in nanoGPT's training loop?
How does nanoGPT generate new text, and what do temperature and top-k change?
What common mistakes does the Hugging Face text generation guide warn about?

sources.title: The Little Book of Deep Learning
